recommendations.title: Stardew Valley
recommendations.reason: A relaxed farming sim with no fail states and a gentle soundtrack you can turn down — ideal to half-watch while a podcast plays.

recommendations.title: Dorfromantik
recommendations.reason: A quiet tile-laying puzzler. Slow, meditative, and entirely playable with the game audio muted.

recommendations.title: Slay the Spire
recommendations.reason: Turn-based deckbuilding means you set the pace — pause to listen, resume when you're ready, no reflexes required.
